meta.titel: MAIS ESPORTE: those who have learned, pass it on
meta.omschrijving: MAIS ESPORTE trains young people in Brazilian favelas to become Urban Adventure Coaches: sports leaders who then guide the children in their own neighbourhood. For organisations looking beyond sponsorship.

hero.inleiding: MAIS ESPORTE trains young people in Brazilian favelas to become Urban Adventure Coaches, sports leaders who can also organise adventurous and challenging activities. They then guide the children in their own neighbourhood through sport and play. A generation defined not by where they come from, but by what they are capable of.
hero.geloof: We believe that a period as a sports leader, under the guidance of an experienced coach, helps these young people enormously in making the step to the labour market. Along the way they learn and practise all kinds of skills that matter at work.

waarom.inleiding: In north eastern Brazil, a large group of young people grows up in conditions where opportunities are scarce and negative influences are present every day. Many lack access to good education, stable work, safe living conditions and inspiring role models.
waarom.keerpunt: Yet that is exactly where the potential lies. We believe young people do not need pity, but trust, responsibility and the chance to develop themselves.

visie.slot: Our aim is to develop a model that can also be used in other regions and countries.

centrum.inleiding: Sitio (estate) Vale da Serra lies in the mountains of Maranguape, in the state of Ceará, just 25 km from the capital Fortaleza in north eastern Brazil.
alineas: The site covers 75 hectares, rich in nature, water, waterfalls, rivers and natural pools that fill during the rainy season. Seven kilometres of walking trails run through it, and 22 educational platforms have been built: clearings in the forest with their own specific infrastructure, each with its own pedagogical purpose.

Sitio Vale da Serra grew out of the dream of creating a place where young people with few opportunities can develop socially and emotionally through experiential learning. That method recognises the value of "learning by doing", the connection with nature, and young people being the captain of their own learning.

Vale da Serra was founded by two physical education teachers (Onno Raadsen and Milza Gomes Raadsen), both with extensive experience in human development through sport and play in countries including Brazil, the Netherlands, Guatemala, Haiti, Timor Leste and several African countries.

partner.begin: A partnership does not have to be large or long term from the start. First get to know MAIS ESPORTE through an inspiring workshop or training for your team. Onno runs interactive sessions on location or elsewhere, based on the experiential method young people in Brazil use to work on their personal development. Leadership, cooperation, resilience and personal development can be at the centre. The workshop can be booked entirely on its own, with no further obligation.
